'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Barry Alperstein LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Like A Play I Once Wrote, This Is Untitled
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
